messages:
maria: Quick sync — profiler shows rerank/embeddings endpoint p99 tail spikes when continuous-batcher hits token_budget. sharing logs and config.
kevin: Which endpoint and config? any links to traces?
maria: rerank_v2 on non-chat API. seq len distribution mostly 32-64, but a few long docs cause token_budget to get consumed and trigger a batcher window stretch + kernel fallback. p50 fine, p99 huge.
ben: can you paste the profiler summary and current batcher config?
maria: profiler snippet:\n\n[profiler]\np50: 45ms\np95: 120ms\np99: 740ms\nhot_path: kv_cache_misses -> batch_formation_wait(>20ms) -> kernel:int8_gemm_fallback\n\nand current batcher config:\n\n```\nbatcher:\n  max_window_ms: 20\n  token_budget_per_batch: 1024\n  priority_decay_ms: 50\n  queue_policy: priority_strict\n  per_model_scaling: false\n```\n\nkevin: interesting — KV cache misses for reranker? we generally don't use KV for non-autoregressive scoring; maybe the request tagging/dispatcher is setting is_chat=true somewhere.
sara: I dug into the request tagging last week; there's a code path where embedding/rerank requests that include 'context' get routed to the autoreg pipeline for a unified code path. might be a perf footgun.
maria: proposed quick changes to test in canary:
- switch queue_policy to `windowed_fair` so short queries don't sit behind a long token-budget consumer
- reduce max_window_ms -> 12ms to favor latency over batching for this endpoint
- enable per_model_scaling: true with token_budget scaling {small:512, default:1024, large:2048}
- add kernel_hint: prefer_fp16 for seq <= 128, fallback order preserved

luis: ran a small canary on eu-dedicated with those changes: p99 dropped from 740ms -> 410ms, p95 120 -> 95, p50 unchanged. throughput delta -3% overall. CPU usage +6% on runner shards.
ben: any correctness impact? outputs identical?
maria: ran automated regression eval on sample prompt-set: no changes in reranker ordering. all diffs are numeric noise.
infra-bot: canary deploy logs: deploy start 1775002600, canary instances up 1775002645, metrics window 1775002650-1775002730, deploy finished 1775002740
kevin: solid. next steps:
1) roll to us-hosted for 12h with tightened alerting on kernel_fallback_count and p99
2) add telemetry fields: `kernel_fallback_count`, `per_batch_token_drain`, `batch_wait_ms`, `queue_head_age_ms`
3) add unit/integration test for kernel selection heuristic for seq boundaries (<=128 vs >128)
4) follow-up task to remove legacy autoreg routing for embedding-only requests

sara: I'll own telemetry PR (ETA EOD). maria will open rollout ticket and run 12h canary. luis will watch infra dashboards and revert if errors >0.1%.
maria: ack. creating ticket now and attaching perf traces and the canary result table. will also include sample request traces showing kv_cache_miss->batch_wait chain.
kevin: thanks. if the us canary looks good, let's ship to prod with a short maintenance window to monitor p99. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — will post update in this thread after the us canary finishes.
